map.基于4%法则，计算退休所需资金与资产增长: Based on the 4% rule, computes retirement savings needed and asset growth
map.所需资金池 ≈ 年支出 / 4%（即约 25 倍年支出）；缺口 = 目标资金池: Required pool ≈ annual spending / 4% (about 25× annual spending); gap = target pool − current assets grown at compound return
map.基于 4% 提取法则：退休资金池约为年支出的 25 倍；现有资产按预期收益复利增: Based on the 4% withdrawal rule: the retirement pool is about 25× annual spending; current assets grow at the expected return and are compared with the target to derive the gap and required annual savings, for retirement planning.
map.：是由威廉·本根（William Bengen）在1994年提出的退休提取策略。: : a retirement withdrawal strategy proposed by William Bengen in 1994.
map.退休第一年从投资组合中提取4%作为生活费，之后每年根据通胀率调整提取金额，在历史: In the first retirement year, withdraw 4% of the portfolio for living expenses, then adjust the amount annually by inflation; historically this strategy sustains at least 30 years without depleting the funds.
map.所需退休资金 = 年支出 / 4% = 年支出 × 25: Required retirement funds = annual spending / 4% = annual spending × 25
map.投资组合中股票占比50%-75%，长期年化收益率约7%左右，扣除通胀后实际收益率: Portfolio 50%–75% equities, long-term annual return ~7%, real return after inflation ~4%.
map.注：本计算器提供参考，实际退休规划建议咨询专业理财顾问。: Note: this calculator is for reference; for actual retirement planning consult a professional advisor.
map.基于 4% 法则估算退休所需资金池: Estimate the required retirement pool based on the 4% rule
map.模拟资产增长轨迹与退休资金缺口: Simulate the asset-growth path and retirement-funds gap
map.比较不同储蓄率与收益率下的退休年龄: Compare retirement age under different savings rates and returns
map.示例：退休后月支出 8000 元、4% 法则: Example: post-retirement monthly spending 8,000 yuan, 4% rule
map.所需资金池 ≈ 8000×12/4% = 240 万元；页面结合当前储蓄与年投入: Required pool ≈ 8000×12/4% = 2.4M yuan; the page simulates the years needed given current savings and annual contributions.
map.由 Bengen 研究提出的经验法则：退休首年提取资产 4% 并按通胀调整，历史: An empirical rule from Bengen: withdraw 4% of assets in the first retirement year and adjust by inflation; historically sustainable for 30 years in most cases; not guaranteed.
map.通胀对退休规划影响大吗？: Does inflation significantly affect retirement planning?
map.影响很大。长期通胀显著抬高退休后开支的现值，规划时应以扣除通胀后的: Very significantly. Long-term inflation markedly raises the present value of post-retirement spending; planning should use the inflation-adjusted
map.结果能当作退休计划吗？: Can the result serve as a retirement plan?
map.不能。预期寿命、医疗支出、市场波动与养老金政策都会影响结果，建议结合专业规划。: No. Life expectancy, medical costs, market volatility and pension policy all affect the result; combine with professional planning.
map.退休金计算器。输入当前资产、每年储蓄与距退休年限，工具基于 4% 法则估算退休所: Retirement Calculator. Enter current assets, annual savings and years to retirement; the tool estimates the required retirement pool and asset-growth path based on the 4% rule, for retirement reserve planning.
